notes: Runs on Decimal.clone({ precision: 40 }), not the default 20 significant digits, which would round the products (up to 27 digits). times and plus, then toDecimalPlaces(2, ROUND_HALF_EVEN) and toFixed(2).
details: Not the default configuration: decimal.js rounds every result to 20 significant digits by default, which would round products of up to 27 digits, so the adapter works on Decimal.clone({ precision: 40 }). There is no entry at the default precision because it would return wrong digits.
